summary: Frontend-only testing for Layout Configurator room external dimensions (Wymiary zewnętrzne) feature. All 3 requested features verified and working correctly.

features_tested.feature: Wymiary zewnętrzne (cm) section with Szerokość and Wysokość fields
features_tested.details: When a room is selected, the Properties panel shows a green section 'Wymiary zewnętrzne (cm)' with two editable fields: 'Szerokość' (width) and 'Wysokość' (height). Default values are 200cm x 150cm.

features_tested.feature: Room resizes on canvas when width/height changed
features_tested.details: Changed width from 200 to 250cm and height from 150 to 180cm. The room visually resized on canvas via scaleX/scaleY transforms. Canvas labels updated accordingly showing 'zewn: 250.7 cm' for width.

features_tested.feature: Internal dimensions auto-calculation (Wewnętrzne: X × Y cm)
features_tested.details: Below the dimension fields, the internal dimensions are displayed: 'Wewnętrzne: 241.2 × 171.2 cm'. This is correctly calculated as (outerWidth - wallLeft - wallRight) × (outerHeight - wallTop - wallBottom) = (250 - 4.4 - 4.4) × (180 - 4.4 - 4.4) = 241.2 × 171.2 cm

code_review_findings.lines_4033_4102: Implementation is correct. The 'Wymiary zewnętrzne (cm)' section is conditionally rendered when selectedObject.isRoomGroup is true.
code_review_findings.lines_4046_4062: Width change handler correctly: 1) converts cm to pixels, 2) calculates scale, 3) applies scaleX, 4) updates outerWidthCm, 5) renders canvas, 6) calls updateDimensionLabels()
code_review_findings.lines_4074_4090: Height change handler follows same pattern with scaleY and outerHeightCm
code_review_findings.lines_4095_4101: Internal dimensions calculated correctly using formula: (outerWidth - wallLeft - wallRight) × (outerHeight - wallTop - wallBottom)

critical_code_review_comments: Feature implementation is complete and correct
Green section (Wymiary zewnętrzne) correctly appears above orange section (Grubość ścian) as required
